sections.text: Enter your Skio API credentials below. You can find your API token in the Skio admin under Settings > API.

sections.label: API Token
sections.hint: Found in the Skio dashboard under API & Integrations > API Keys.

sections.text: The settings below decide which money-moving actions your agents may take. Each one is off until you turn it on, and an agent who tries a blocked action is told which setting an admin needs to change. Agents also have to tick a confirmation box for any of these, and every change an agent makes is stamped into Skio's audit trail as coming from Gladly.

sections.label: Discount codes agents may apply
sections.hint: Comma-separated Skio discount codes. Agents can apply only these; anything else is refused. Leave blank to stop agents applying discounts at all.

sections.label: Allow agents to override prices
sections.hint: Covers a custom price when adding a product, changing a line, or swapping a variant. With this off, agents can still make those changes at your catalogue prices.

sections.label: Allow agents to override shipping price
sections.hint: Lets an agent waive or reduce shipping on a subscription as goodwill. Skio flags the override so a catalogue resync will not undo it.

sections.label: Allow agents to set commitment offers
sections.hint: Turns a cancellation into added required cycles. It restricts when the customer may cancel, so leave it off unless your retention playbook uses it.

sections.label: Allow agents to change the payment method
sections.hint: Lets an agent move a subscription onto a card the customer has already saved in your store - the usual fix for a declined card. Agents never see or enter card details.

sections.label: Allow agents to permanently cancel
sections.hint: A permanent cancellation can never be reactivated. Ordinary cancellation is always available and is reversible, so most merchants leave this off.

sections.label: Allow AI and agents to ship the next order now
sections.hint: Ship-now creates an unscheduled order and charges the payment method on file straight away. Leave this off unless you want AI and agents to be able to bill a customer ahead of their normal schedule.
